About

One person from sketch to store.

Who

I'm Mohamed Abd Elhafez, a designer and developer. I start with how a product should feel, then build it for the web, Android and iOS so nothing gets lost between design and code.

I work across frontend interfaces, Arabic-first experiences and mobile products, turning ideas into clear, reviewable software.

What I do

  • UI/UX design: research, flows, prototypes and design systems.
  • Full-stack development: front ends, APIs and databases.
  • Mobile apps for Android and iOS, from first build to store release.
